name: audio_cepstral
expr: c1 = cepstralCoefficients(S); c1_1 = c1(1); c1_2 = c1(2); c1_4 = c1(4); c1_6 = c1(6); c2 = cepstralCoefficients(S2); c2_21 = c2(2,1); c2_22 = c2(2,2); c2_24 = c2(2,4); c2_25 = c2(2,5); [mc, md, mdd] = mfcc(xs, fs); mfcc_R = size(mc, 1); mfcc_C = size(mc, 2); mfcc_logE = mc(1,1); mfcc_dc = mc(1,2); mfcc_c2 = mc(1,3); mfcc_cend = mc(1,end); mfcc_f2_dc = mc(2,2); [gc, gd, gdd] = gtcc(xs, fs); gtcc_R = size(gc, 1); gtcc_C = size(gc, 2); gtcc_logE = gc(1,1); gtcc_dc = gc(1,2); gtcc_c2 = gc(1,3); gtcc_cend = gc(1,end); gtcc_f2_dc = gc(2,2); cnv = cepstralCoefficients(S2, 'NumCoeffs', 3); cbrt = cepstralCoefficients(S2, 'NumCoeffs', 3, 'Rectification', 'cubic-root'); cnone = cepstralCoefficients(S2, 'NumCoeffs', 3, 'Rectification', 'none'); cz = cepstralCoefficients(Sz, 'NumCoeffs', 2); c3 = cepstralCoefficients(S3, 'NumCoeffs', 2); csgl = cepstralCoefficients(single(S));
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycles D + G + H: cepstralCoefficients (bit-equal — DCT-II unitary matrix from createDCTmatrix.m + log10 rectification, output shape M×NumCoeffs). Cycle G: mfcc BIT-EQUAL with MATLAB R2025b — Slaney band edges (audio.internal.slaneybandedges, 42 entries: 13 linear at 66.66 Hz step + 29 log-spaced ratio 1.0711703), Slaney designMelFilterBank ('Hz' designDomain, 'Bandwidth' normalization), |FFT| magnitude, natural-log per-frame energy of UNWINDOWED signal as first column ('append' LogEnergy default). Cycle H: gtcc BIT-EQUAL with MATLAB R2025b — proper Patterson-Holdsworth gammatone filterbank (Slaney 1993) via cascaded 4-stage biquads with frequency-domain freqz('whole') evaluation, FrequencyRange=[50,fs/2], NumFilters=ceil(hz2erb(fs/2)-hz2erb(50)), Bandwidth normalization BW[i]/2, OneSided=false equivalent via doubled inner-half bins. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship cepstralCoefficients/mfcc/gtcc in core (Audio package only). Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: signature is cepstralCoefficients(S[, Name=Value]) - a positional NumCoeffs is TooManyInputs in R2025b; NumCoeffs (ci+prefix NV names) integer > 1; Rectification in {'log','cubic-root','none'}; S is double/single real, NONNEGATIVE for log/cubic-root; zero bins clamp to realmin before log10 (finite, not -Inf); 3-D input transforms along dim 1 with output (d2, K, d3); single in = single out. Deferred: none on these branches.
